title: He Sold A Fake Vermeer To Goering. Then Proved It. 🎨
caption:
True story. A Dutch forger was arrested for treason for selling a Vermeer to Goering. His defense: it was fake. 🎨
Would you have spotted the fake? 👇
first_comment: He literally painted a new fake in custody to prove he was a forger, not a traitor. Genius or just lucky? 🎨👇
